records.name: Tacony Civic Association
records.summary: Tacony neighbors who hold general membership meetings on the second Wednesday of the month, elect their leaders at the May meeting, and share local news such as a community yard sale and a planned garden.
records.what_you_do: Come to a membership meeting, join as a member, or send news and event ideas to the group by email for its website.

schedule.text: General membership meetings on the second Wednesday of the month at 7 pm, in January, March, May, September and November

locations.label: Tacony Free Library (meeting place on the City list)

cost.text: The site does not state dues.

first_step.how: Email the association to ask about joining, then come to the next general membership meeting
first_step.basis: The site has a membership page and a membership video, but it does not give dues, a meeting place, or the steps to join.

records.notes: The old address taconycivic.org redirects to the Google Sites page. The site lists a P.O. Box mailing address, P.O. Box 8979, Philadelphia, PA 19135. The site says the meeting place is announced in its newsletter; the City list names the library. The site shows no dated items with a year.

records.name: Upper Holmesburg Civic Association
records.summary: A civic group for Upper Holmesburg that meets monthly to talk about the neighborhood. Members pay small dues, and the group posts news and events on its website and social pages.
records.what_you_do: Come to a monthly meeting, join as a member, or look at the scholarship and Hometown Hero pages on the group's site.

schedule.text: Monthly meetings. The site lists its next meeting as 10/15, with no year shown.

cost.text: Membership dues are $10 for regular members, $5 for seniors and $25 for businesses, per the membership page. Dues are paid through the site's online donate option.

first_step.how: Come to a monthly meeting, or join through the membership page on the group's site
first_step.basis: The group invites residents and workers to its monthly meetings, but the site shows no meeting time and no contact email.

records.notes: The 2026 in the site footer is a copyright line and was not used as evidence. The 10/15 meeting notice has no year. The events page is empty. The City list shows the group registered as of April 2026.

records.name: Friends of Tacony Creek Park
records.summary: Volunteers who help care for Tacony Creek Park, a 300 acre watershed park in lower Northeast Philadelphia. They lead free weekly walks and runs and run cleanups under a program called CreekyClean.
records.what_you_do: Join a free walk or run in the park, or sign up on the volunteer page to help with a cleanup.

schedule.text: Free walks and runs in the park each week, plus cleanups. The events page has the times and places.

cost.text: The recurring trail programs are described as free.

first_step.how: Check the events page and join a walk or run, or use the volunteer page to help with a cleanup
first_step.basis: Free public walks and runs are listed with a volunteer page, but the site does not say that beginners are welcome.

records.notes: The old address tcpkeepers.org redirects to this site. The site says it is a registered Philadelphia Parks and Recreation friends group. The only year on the page appears in an image file path, so it was not used as evidence. The Watershed Partnership site returned HTTP 403 and was not read.

records.name: Tacony Together
records.summary: Tacony's community development group, formerly Tacony CDC. It runs fall events for families, art and sewing classes, a weekly teen open studio, and clean and green projects along Torresdale Avenue.
records.what_you_do: Sign up on the volunteer page (no experience is needed), come to a public event or maker market, or take part in a clean and green project.

schedule.text: A weekly teen open studio, workshops, office hours, and seasonal events such as a fall festival. Check the calendar for times.

cost.text: Costs vary by event. The Fall for Tacony series for children and families is free.

first_step.how: Sign up on the volunteer page or come to a public event. The newsletter sign up is on the site.
first_step.basis: The volunteer page says no experience is required, and events are posted for anyone to join.

records.notes: Renamed from Tacony CDC; the Tacony Civic Association site still uses the old name. Social handles as published: Instagram taconytogether, Facebook taconycdc, YouTube TaconyCDC, TikTok tacony.cdc. Event listings show month and day without a year, so only the September 2026 article was used for status.

records.name: Mayfair-Holmesburg Thanksgiving Parade
records.summary: A volunteer parade committee that puts on the yearly Mayfair-Holmesburg Thanksgiving parade on Frankford Avenue. Clubs, schools, churches, businesses and families can march, and residents can enter homemade floats.
records.what_you_do: Enter a marching unit or a homemade float, or volunteer to carry a banner in the parade.

schedule.text: Annual parade on Sunday, November 22, 2026, from 12 to 3 pm. The committee responds to applications by Friday, November 13, 2026.

locations.label: Frankford Avenue, between Rhawn and Stanwood streets

first_step.how: Email info@thanksgivingparade.org for the marching unit form, or to sign up as a banner carrier
first_step.basis: Residents are invited to enter homemade floats and there is a volunteer banner role for ages 7th grade and up. Units are approved within a week of applying, and no fee is listed.

records.notes: This is the 49th parade, set for November 22, 2026. The committee has no separate website. The starting point on Frankford Avenue comes from the Tacony Civic Association page, which gives no year. Banner carriers earn 6 community service hours.

records.name: Disston Park and Community Garden
records.summary: A community garden planned at Disston Park in Tacony, at the corner of Longshore and Keystone streets. Neighbors can sign up for updates through an interest form.
records.what_you_do: Fill in the community garden interest form, or sign up for text messages by QR code, to hear about garden activities and meetings.

locations.label: Disston Park, corner of Longshore and Keystone streets

first_step.how: Fill in the Community Garden Interest Form linked on the page, or sign up for text messages by QR code
first_step.basis: Anyone can fill in the open interest form, but the page gives no work day or volunteer schedule yet.

records.notes: A project run from the Tacony Civic Association site. The page is undated and does not say whether the garden is built yet. It names no coordinator and gives no contact email.

notes: Spine of this run: the City Planning Commission's List of Registered Community Organizations dated April 13, 2026 (phila.gov PDF), read page by page. It gives meeting places and registration status but not proof of activity. All 6 searches were used, and they returned mostly 2011 to 2019 news, so no undated or older news was used as a fact. Four pages were blocked (see blocked). Most groups in this slice are Facebook only or have no website, so 7 of the 12 publish records are low confidence and rest on the City list alone; their open_to is set to public by default and should be checked. Bridesburg and Frankford east produced no group with its own website beyond the Bridesburg Community Action Alliance entry, which is list only. Out-of-slice City list entries seen but not checked and not listed here: East Torresdale Civic Association, Greater Bustleton Civic League, South Port Richmond Civic Association, Rhawnhurst Civic Association, Northwood Civic Association, Northeast Community Civic Alliance, Olde Richmond Civic Association, Port Richmond On Patrol and Civic Association, Juniata Park Civic Association, Harrowgate Civic Association, Parkwood Area Civic Association. Deliberately not recorded: personal looking emails on the City list, dated items without a year, copyright years, and the Tacony Third Thursday and Mayfair Third Thursday markets (events, not groups). Verdicts: 12 publish, 1 not_a_group, 8 leads.
